description: This file defines an abstract class CheckPermissionsVisitor used for checking permissions on ResourceNode objects within a policy enforcement framework. It provides mechanisms for permission evaluation based on authorization subjects and permission weights, and includes methods for visiting nodes in a permission tree structure.

classes.name: CheckPermissionsVisitor
classes.description: An abstract base class for visitors that verify permissions on ResourceNode objects within a permission tree.

methods.name: CheckPermissionsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the visitor with a resource pointer, authorization subject IDs, and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Visits a PolicyTreeNode, delegating to either subject or resource node handlers based on node type.

methods.name: getLocationInRelationToTargetPointer
methods.description: Returns the relative location of a resource node in relation to the target resource path.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the boolean result of permission checking.

methods.name: aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to aggregate permissions from resource nodes.
